paragraphs: R' Sheila of Kefar Temarta. Rav Assi [R' Assi in the checked Bavli] said: R' Sheila of Kefar Temarta expounded, Megillah 16a. R' Hanina bar Pappa said: R' Sheila of Kefar Temarta expounded, there, b; Sotah 35a; Niddah 26a. He transmitted in R' Yohanan’s name: Bereshit Rabbah 6. That teaching recurs at the end of Jerusalem Talmud, Rosh Hashanah chapter 2 and in Shoher Tov 104. At the end of Homer Ba-Kodesh the same chain transmits a different teaching. R' Levi in his name: Rabbah, Kedoshim chapter 24; Midrash Hazit on ‘My dove in the clefts of the rock.’ Rav Aha was his son, and Levi spoke in his name; see there, and this needs examination.
